title: Product Requirements
description: State what you are building, for whom, and the problem it solves. One page a stranger can understand without your explanations.
deliverables: Problem statement in two sentences
Target user described concretely
Success looks like: three measurable outcomes

title: User Stories
description: Translate requirements into stories of the form: as a [role], I can [action], so that [benefit]. Every feature earns its place through a story.
deliverables: Stories covering every planned feature
Each story names exactly one role and one benefit

title: Acceptance Criteria
description: For every story, the testable conditions that prove it done - including at least one failure case per story.
deliverables: Given/when/then criteria per story
One adversarial criterion per story (what an abusive user would try)

title: Technical Specification
description: The stack decision document: frameworks, storage, hosting, key libraries - each with a one-line justification and rejected alternatives.
deliverables: Stack table with justifications
Constraints declared (budget, scale ceiling, timeline)

title: Architecture
description: The system map: layers, components, data flow direction, and where trust boundaries sit. Drawn in text well enough that another engineer could sketch it.
deliverables: Component diagram in text form
Trust boundary list: what lives inside each boundary and why

title: Data Model
description: Tables, relations, constraints - the schema-first discipline from Level 2 applied to your own domain.
deliverables: ER outline with keys and relations
Migration plan from empty database to full schema

title: API Design
description: Every endpoint before any code: method, path, request shape, response shape, status codes, error envelope.
deliverables: Complete route table with example requests
Error envelope contract documented once, used everywhere

title: Authentication and Authorization Model
description: Who logs in how, what roles exist, and the full permission matrix mapping roles to actions on resources.
deliverables: Auth flows described (register, login, logout, recovery)
Permission matrix: role x resource x action, deny-by-default

title: Security Considerations
description: Threat-list your own application: what could an attacker try against each input, endpoint and role - and what stops them.
deliverables: Threat list per trust boundary with mitigations
Secret management plan (what never enters code or logs)

title: Implementation Plan
description: Ordered build phases mirroring your Level 2 gated approach, each phase small enough to verify in one sitting.
deliverables: Phase list with exit gates
Cut list: features explicitly deferred, with reasons

title: AI-Agent Instructions
description: The standing context document your agent reads every session: project map, conventions, constraints, quality gates it must never skip.
deliverables: Agent context file committed to the repo root
Per-phase task briefs derived from the implementation plan

title: Automated Tests
description: Tests written against acceptance criteria as you build - units for logic, integrations for flows, explicit deny-path assertions.
deliverables: Suite green via one command
Every acceptance criterion maps to at least one assertion

title: Deployment
description: Ship early, ship often: pipeline configured, environment variables documented, rollback rehearsed before anyone depends on the app.
deliverables: Live environment serving the current build
Env var inventory documented; rollback executed once deliberately

title: Observability
description: Logs that answer tomorrow's questions without leaking today's secrets; errors surfaced, not swallowed.
deliverables: Log format documented; sensitive fields proven absent
Health check endpoint responding on production

title: Security Review
description: Adversarial pass over the finished build - the Trust Nothing audit plus authentication and authorization checks run against production.
deliverables: Executed hostile-request suite with results recorded
Isolation and permission checks demonstrated live

title: Performance and Scalability Considerations
description: Where will this break first when real users arrive? Name the bottlenecks honestly and decide which ones matter at YOUR scale.
deliverables: Bottleneck list ranked by likelihood x impact
One improvement implemented OR one scaling trigger documented

title: Production Readiness Review
description: The final gate you run yourself: every artifact above reviewed, every gate green, smoke tests passed - then, and only then, ship and say so publicly.
deliverables: Completed readiness checklist signed off item by item
Post-deploy smoke test evidence
Public announcement only after personal verification passes
